test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FRANK’ is written as ‘121811422’ and ‘CRIED’ is written as ‘618958’. How will ‘GREAT’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc278fe789af8222fe6cac882237358a9d0a2182b555ce3565db4085f8b1202.png] 

The logic follows here is:

‘FRANK’ is written as ‘121811422’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9855ec5ffbdda28c21d8957516efff4b390c08d45f8ead85a01f4f1d1ee1ff05.png] 

‘CRIED’ is written as ‘618958’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f67a65701002fbee630850808e59004db8ac26c1e9d68e2c0bda96cf02613c1.png] 

Similarly, for 'GREAT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1514ba42cba79648ce18fc1d35cc5a683eef91e1ce2d2b3395e7a9bae8b680c4.png] 

So, ‘**GREAT**’ is written as ‘**14185140**’

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
